name: moore-2020-abu-hureyra.pdf
description: A 2020 Scientific Reports study examining Abu Hureyra, Syria, at the Younger Dryas onset (~12.8 ka), reporting high-temperature meltglass, nanodiamonds, microspherules, and elevated platinum-group elements as evidence of a cosmic airburst, with Bayesian dating, lab analyses, and a rebuttal to the opposing Thy et al. view.
